title: Measure the relation-digest delta mapping tax at the existing before/after authority seam

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Reuse the existing GPU-100 relation-delta fixture to test the GPU-105 before/after authority seam. Compute per-plane retained relation-digest set differences, map changed digests back to concrete Forest edges/signatures without a persistent index or cache, and compare affected-signature compilation to the ordinary full compile_relation_blocks oracle. Keep production code unchanged.

bounded_contract_result.oracle: affected-signature compile digest equals the ordinary full Boolean compile_relation_blocks digest
fail_closed: a requested changed digest absent from the supplied authoritative Forest raises instead of being silently dropped
an empty digest delta scans and hashes zero Forest edges
scan repeat bounds reject bool aliases and out-of-range values
bounded_contract_result.interpretation: The existing before/after Fourfold snapshots cheaply identify which canonical retained relation digests changed, but the current authority surface does not map those digests to ForestEdge payloads. In the frozen worst-position one-add case, locating one changed digest therefore requires rehashing every candidate same-plane Forest edge. Digest-set delta alone narrows semantic authority scope but does not provide O(delta) changed-edge work.

decision.finding: Do not build a production incremental Tensor compiler from relation_sha256s alone. The state-owner question is solved by GPU-105, but the payload-selection question remains scan/rehash-bound without an authority-safe digest-to-edge seam.
unsafe_shortcuts_rejected: persistent duplicate Forest edge index owned by Tensor
positional pairing of sorted relation_sha256s with Forest edges
silent skip when a changed digest cannot be located

verification.kind: focused diagnostic contract plus existing Fourfold/Tensor integration workflow

claim_boundaries: No production incremental Tensor path exists as a result of GPU-106.
No claim that relation-digest deltas can currently locate changed ForestEdge payloads in O(delta).
No latency or memory superiority claim; the contract's wall timing fields are diagnostic only and deterministic scan/hash counts are the primary evidence.
No Tensor-vs-Forest, GPU/Tensor-Core, CrewAI or AlphaEvolve superiority claim.
No OwnerApproval, PromotionReceipt, merge, Ready-for-Review or Gate transition.
next_bounded_step: GPU-107 should audit the existing Fourfold/Forest production path that already computes relation digests and determine whether a transient revision-bound digest-to-edge or digest-to-signature receipt can be reused at run_gate1_ignition without persisting a second graph authority. Prefer deleting duplicate hash work or threading an already-owned ephemeral value. If the current producer discards the association and recovering it requires a new persistent index or public contract, close that as negative evidence before proposing a schema change.
